text:
maria.partnerships: Quick ask — we need to finalize the attack-surface matrix & presign flow for the ACME SI + HW listing. Who owns each artifact (SOC/pen reports, network diagrams, redaction copies)?

aj.security: Short answer: security owns SOC/pen scoping and redaction rules; partnerships owns owner contact. Need confirmation on presign TTL and storage location.

sam.engineering: For presigns we planned S3 pre-signed URLs with 7-day TTL by default. We can shorten per partner. Example CLI to generate:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace/acme/pen-tests/2026-03-01.zip --expires-in 604800
```

lee.sis: Lee here — SIS will take on evidence ingest and retention mapping if partnerships provides owner mapping and the target S3 prefix. Can we get a CSV of artifact -> owner -> target-prefix?

maria.partnerships: Yeah, I'll build the CSV. For attack-surface matrix columns: artifact, owner, required-redaction? (Y/N), presign-ttl, ingress-method (s3/upload-ui/secure-share), contact-email.

aj.security: Add 'sensitive-subjects' column (e.g., customer-data, keys, creds) and 'review-frequency'. Also note: pen-test raw results must be redacted before S3 upload; legal needs to sign off on redaction checklist.

ingrid.legal: Confirmed. I'll attach the redaction checklist once you map which artifacts contain PII or secrets. Also prefer presigns expire <=72h for any file that includes customer data.

sam.engineering: We can support TTL per-presign. Lee, do you want a separate 'redacted' prefix vs 'raw' (airgapped) prefix? We can set bucket policies to block public presigns for raw.

lee.sis: Yes — plan: /raw/ (access-controlled, no presigns) and /redacted/ (presigned links allowed). We'll schedule a handoff runbook for onboarding.

maria.partnerships: Plan: I will draft CSV + runbook by EOD Monday, include mapping and contact emails. @aj.security, @ingrid.legal — can you confirm presign TTL policy and redaction checklist by Tue noon?

aj.security: I'll review Tue morning. :thumbsup: 

ingrid.legal: On it.

artifact-bot: New presign bucket policy draft uploaded: https://storage.internal/redwood/presign-policy/draft-v2.md

sam.engineering: Quick note: we should include an artifact manifest (JSON) with each upload: {"artifact_name":...,"sha256":...,"redacted":true/false}

maria.partnerships: Good call. Add 'manifest_required' column to CSV. I'll also add a column for 'announcement_ok' flag (whether artifact can be quoted in joint press).

lee.sis: Agree. Also let's set a TTL matrix: public-marketing 7d, partner-only 3d, sensitive 72h. We'll enforce via presign generator.

aj.security: One more: pen-test vendor report must include scope page (attack surface matrix). If SI/HW partner provides different scope, we need a merged matrix — partnership to coordinate.

maria.partnerships: Thanks. I'll ping ACME SI and hardware contact for scope sync after I post the CSV. Closing loop: deliver CSV + runbook + initial presign policy link Monday EOD. Anything else?

lee.sis: Add a verification step for manifest SHA matching after upload.

sam.engineering: Will add SHA check to ingest lambda.

maria.partnerships: Perfect. I'll update thread when CSV is ready. Thanks all. :pray:
